title: The Stranger
author: Albert Camus
summary: Meursault, a detached clerk in French Algeria, attends his mother's funeral without grief and, soon after, commits a killing on a beach. His trial turns less on the act than on how he behaves.
readIf: you want a short, cold classic of existentialist fiction.
skipIf: you want an emotional connection to the narrator; he is deliberately flat.

pairings.reason: Camus's larger novel about a town under siege, more humane and hopeful.
Another novel about a killer's mind and a society that judges him, more feverish and moral.
Another short, strange story about an alienated man and a world that doesn't care.
